take: While Kaynes maintains revenue growth of 40.6% YoY in Q1 FY27, net profit fell 25.3% and operating cash flow remains deeply negative. Stretched working capital cycles and execution delays in smart metering create severe cash burn that offsets order book expansion.

bull.point: Revenue increased 40.6% YoY to ₹946 crore in Q1 FY27, backed by an ₹83,663 million order book.
Standalone EMS grew 53% YoY, and commercial OSAT production commenced sample shipments to three international customers.
International manufacturing footprint expanded through acquisitions including August Electronics in Canada and Sensonic GmbH in Austria.

bear.point: Cash generation is deeply impaired: FY26 CFO hit -₹600 crore and 5-year profit-to-operating-cash conversion stands at -63%.
Working capital cycle lengthened significantly, with debtor days doubling to 154 days and working capital days reaching 133.
Net profit fell 25.3% YoY in Q1 FY27 and 21.6% in Q4 FY26, showing persistent margin strain.
Smart metering subsidiary suffers severe cash flow drag and high receivables due to ground-level installation delays.

watch: Reversal of negative operating cash flows and inventory additions.
Smart metering receivable recoveries or updates on potential business divestment.
Execution toward the lowered INR 450-500 crore OSAT and PCB target.
